Product Overview

Upgrade your vehicle's towing capability with this Class 3 trailer hitch, engineered for a precise fit on select Pontiac Torrent and Saturn Vue models. Built with heavy-duty steel construction and a durable black powder coat finish, this hitch delivers reliable performance for hauling trailers, cargo carriers, bike racks, and more. With a standard 2-inch receiver opening, this hitch is ready to handle your towing and hauling needs right out of the box.

Features

  • Class 3 receiver hitch with standard 2-inch receiver opening
  • Durable black powder coat finish for long-lasting corrosion resistance
  • Heavy-duty steel construction for reliable towing performance
  • Vehicle-specific design for a precise, bolt-on installation
  • Compatible with a wide range of hitch-mounted accessories including bike racks, cargo carriers, and tow balls

Vehicle Fitment

  • 2006-2009 Pontiac Torrent
  • 2002-2007 Saturn Vue

Product Overview

This comprehensive RV trailer hitch combo package includes a 72" adjustable Class 3 trailer hitch paired with a 2" loaded ball mount featuring a pre-torqued 1-7/8" trailer ball, pin, and clip. Designed for RV frames up to 72" wide, this universal kit delivers everything you need for safe and reliable towing right out of the box.

  • Complete combo kit includes Class 3 trailer hitch and loaded ball mount

Product Overview

Protect your Dodge Ram's truck bed with this lightweight V2 rubber bed mat, engineered specifically for 5.7 ft short bed models equipped with the RamBox Cargo Management System. Designed for 2002–2022 Dodge Ram 1500, 2500, and 3500 trucks, this durable mat provides a custom-fit, non-slip surface that shields your bed floor from scratches, dents, and everyday wear.

Features

  • Custom Fit for RamBox Models: Precisely designed to fit 5.7 ft (68.4") short bed trucks equipped with the RamBox Cargo Management System — not compatible with standard (non-RamBox) beds
  • Lightweight V2 Construction: Updated lightweight rubber design makes installation and removal easier without sacrificing durability or protection
  • Rubber Material: Heavy-duty rubber construction resists cracking, warping, and UV damage for long-lasting bed protection
  • Non-Slip Surface: Textured rubber surface keeps cargo secure and prevents shifting during transport
  • Protects Bed Finish: Guards against scratches, dents, and moisture damage to preserve your truck bed's value
  • Easy to Clean: Rubber surface wipes clean quickly and resists stains, fluids, and debris

Vehicle Fitment

  • 2002–2010 Dodge Ram 1500 — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only
  • 2011–2018 Dodge Ram 1500 — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only
  • 2019–2022 Dodge Ram 1500 Classic — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only (Will NOT fit 2019+ Ram 1500 New Body Style)
  • 2003–2010 Dodge Ram 2500 — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only
  • 2011–2018 Dodge Ram 2500 — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only (Will NOT fit 5th Generation Ram 2500)
  • 2003–2010 Dodge Ram 3500 — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only
  • 2011–2018 Dodge Ram 3500 — 5.7 ft Bed, RamBox Models Only (Will NOT fit 5th Generation Ram 3500)

Important: This mat is designed exclusively for trucks equipped with the RamBox Cargo Management System. It will not fit standard Ram trucks without RamBox. It also does not fit the 2019 and newer Ram 1500 new body style (DS generation) or 5th generation Ram 2500/3500 models.

Specifications

  • MPN: AA020-V2
  • Part Number: TBM-RAM09-5.5-RB-V2
